tips.tricepsShare: Your triceps make up more than half of your upper arm. Your biceps only about a third.
tips.deepSquats: Deep squats build about three times as much glute as half squats.
tips.overheadTriceps: Overhead triceps extensions grow the long head about 45 % more than cable pushdowns.
tips.seatedLegCurl: Seated leg curls grow your hamstrings about 50 % more than lying ones.
tips.weeklySets: 10 or more sets per muscle a week bring almost twice the growth of fewer than 5.
tips.alcohol: Alcohol after training cuts muscle building by up to 37 %. With a protein shake, it’s still 24 %.
tips.sleepDiet: On a diet with 5.5 instead of 8.5 hours of sleep, you lose less than half the fat and clearly more muscle.
tips.growthHormone: In men, about 70 % of the day’s growth hormone is released in the first hours of sleep.
tips.iceBath: A 10-minute ice bath after every workout slows strength and muscle gains over 12 weeks. Save it for rest days.
tips.longerRest: Resting 3 minutes instead of 1 between sets gets you more reps and more strength and muscle.
tips.proteinTarget: 1.6 g of protein per kg a day is enough for maximum muscle growth. At 75 kg (165 lb), that’s 120 g.
tips.proteinFood: 250 g of Greek yogurt has about 25 g of protein, as much as 4 eggs.
tips.casein: 40 g of protein before bed, e.g. from cottage cheese, feeds your muscles through the night.
tips.deficitProtein: In a calorie deficit you need more protein, not less: up to 2.2 g per kg of body weight (1 g per lb).
tips.proteinPowder: Protein powder is just food in powder form. It builds no more muscle than chicken or yogurt with the same protein.
tips.creatine: Creatine: 3–5 g a day, rest days too. Without a loading phase, your muscles are full after about 4 weeks.
tips.creatineWater: Creatine often adds 1–2 kg (2–4 lb). That’s water in your muscles, not fat.
tips.caffeine: Caffeine 30–60 minutes before training makes you stronger. 3 mg per kg is enough, more mostly brings a racing heart.
tips.energyDrink: A 500 ml can of Monster has 160 mg of caffeine, as much as two espressos.
tips.peptides: Peptides like BPC-157 are barely studied in humans, not approved as medicines and on the doping list.
tips.leanBulk: A lean bulk needs only 200–300 kcal over maintenance a day. Much more mostly adds fat.
tips.fatKcal: A kilo of body fat stores about 7,700 kcal. So a 500 kcal daily deficit is about a kilo (2 lb) in two weeks.
tips.fasting: At the same calories, intermittent fasting burns no more fat than a normal diet. It’s just one way to eat less.
tips.cutPace: Cutting at 0.7 % instead of 1.4 % a week: at the slow pace you even build a little muscle, at the fast one you don’t.
tips.dietBreaks: 2 weeks of dieting, 2 weeks at maintenance, in turn: that brought about 50 % more fat loss than dieting straight through.
tips.sleepTestosterone: A week of 5 hours of sleep a night lowers your testosterone by 10–15 %.
tips.testoBoosters: Tribulus and other testosterone boosters don’t measurably raise your testosterone.
tips.ffmi: An FFMI over 25 is very rare without steroids. At 1.80 m (5′11″), that’s about 81 kg (179 lb) of fat-free mass.
tips.hormoneSpikes: The hormone spike after training only lasts a short while and doesn’t make your muscles bigger.
tips.muscleVolume: 1 kg of muscle weighs as much as 1 kg of fat, but takes up about 15 % less space.
tips.glutes: Your gluteus maximus is the largest muscle in your body.
tips.muscleWater: Muscle is about 75 % water. That’s why your weight moves from day to day.
tips.glycogen: Every gram of stored carbs holds about 3 g of water. That’s why the scale jumps after pizza night.
tips.creatineKidneys: Creatine harms your kidneys? Not healthy ones. It can only raise the creatinine value in a blood test.
tips.creatineHair: Creatine makes you bald? It can raise DHT, but hair loss from creatine has never been shown.
tips.bcaa: BCAAs for more muscle? If you eat enough protein, they add nothing.
tips.anabolicWindow: A shake within 30 minutes after training? How much protein you eat over the day matters far more.
tips.spotReduction: Ab exercises to burn belly fat? You lose fat all over your body, not where you train.
tips.swap: Machine taken? Swap the exercise mid-workout for a matching alternative.
tips.plates: When you log a set, Loqqa shows which plates go on each side of the bar.
tips.kai: Ask Kai why your bench press has stalled. He answers with your own data.
